summary: Frontend-only regression test of the 'e.filter is not a function' crash fix. Verified normal rendering of / , /shop, and a product detail page, then simulated a broken products/offers API via Playwright route interception (404 non-array and 200 plain-object). No 'is not a function' TypeError and no blank page in any scenario. Shop tab filtering and a malformed product (sizes as object) were also exercised successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx order() still dereferences product.sizes[sizeIdx] without a guard (line ~34). If a product has no/invalid sizes, clicking 'Order on WhatsApp' throws (reproduced state: PDP renders with 0 size options, button enabled). Suggest: const size = Array.isArray(product.sizes) ? product.sizes[sizeIdx] : null; and bail out / disable the button when size is missing.
seed_data_creation: None. Broken responses were mocked client-side via page.route only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified scenarios: (1) Home normal -> hero + 4 product cards, no console errors. (2) /shop normal -> tabs All(4)/Attars(2)/Perfumes(2), grid 4 items, tab filtering works. (3) PDP 'Oud Royale' -> name, 1 size option, WhatsApp button visible. (4) products+offers mocked as 404 {'detail':'Not Found'} -> Home renders hero/sections/footer, Shop shows All(0) + 'No products in this category yet.' empty state, zero function-type TypeErrors. (5) same with 200 {'message':'oops'} -> no errors at all. (6) /api/products/* mocked with sizes as an object -> PDP renders with 0 size options, no crash. Only residual console warning: React 'empty string passed to src attribute' when product.image is ''. Remaining unguarded spot: ProductDetail order() handler.
rca_of_the_issue: Original crash came from calling .filter() directly on axios r.data when the API returned a non-array (404/error object). The Array.isArray coercion at setState in Home.jsx/Shop.jsx plus derived-line guards fully prevent the TypeError; confirmed by interception-based reproduction attempts which no longer crash.
